plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure and stop losses.

conservative.read: This conservative plan targets capital preservation with a potential ~1.5%/month return. It significantly reduces risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and lowering concentration, but growth potential is limited.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 2% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure while maintaining some upside.
Trim SPY to 25% and CRWD to 10% to meet concentration limits and reduce overall risk.
Buy ADI at 5% and ZS at 5% to add high-scoring tech setups, balancing growth and risk.

balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5%/month growth by blending broad index, quality tech, and small leverage. It aims for a moderate risk profile, reducing concentration while seeking growth opportunities.

plan: Trim SPY to 25% to meet the concentration mandate.

aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth by leaning into leveraged ETFs and high-scoring setups. Be aware this significantly raises both upside and drawdown potential, and leveraged ETFs decay daily. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell SOXL, SPAL, CRWD, and SMH to zero, eliminating all leveraged and high-beta holdings.

income.read: This income plan targets ~1%/month by rotating into income/covered-call ETFs and broad index. It prioritizes low drawdown and reliable distributions, but NAV can still fall in selloffs, and distributions are variable.
